summary: Steep cul-de-sac kerb with homes 6-14 m away; too steep for sleeping.

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 6 m, 9 m and 14 m from the kerb on both sides.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed court; kerb room exists but the whole stretch climbs steeply.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along it in the imagery; no signs.

sun_shade: Open to sky; no tree cover on the kerb.
